description: Which controls the License row offers in each state (docs/spec/license.md § States and copy). The native shells do NOT decide this: they render `license_surface_row_actions` (iOS: its yes/no adapter `license_row_actions`), which also owns what each purchase surface hides. Desktop, which landed first and is always link-out, still derives its two buttons inline in Svelte.
note: Partial: the Rust side is a golden (`the_row_actions_are_the_specified_table`, `link_out_false_hides_every_way_out_of_the_app_and_nothing_else`) and both native shells read it — iOS through `LicenseModel.rowActions(linkOut:)` (`licenseEvidenceRowActions`, which adds the App Store purchase's controls, ADR-0009), Android through `LicenseModel.actions()` (`licenseSurfaceRowActions`) — so they cannot drift from each other. The desktop Svelte copy is covered only by the spec table it was written from.
